name: portfolio-copilot
description: Portfolio Copilot — an MCP-based agent with a full-stack Next.js UI, powered by the Anthropic API.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n mcp,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @portfolio-copilot/mcp-server" "npm run dev -w @portfolio-copilot/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @portfolio-copilot/mcp-server && npm run build -w @portfolio-copilot/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @portfolio-copilot/mcp-server && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
